# Diving Sanatan Sanctuary — LLMs.txt

> Diving Sanatan Sanctuary is a holistic energy healing center offering
> chakra alignment, Reiki, sound healing, pranayama breath-work, crystal
> therapy, meditation retreats, and mindfulness workshops.

## About

Diving Sanatan Sanctuary provides authentic, practitioner-led energy
healing services rooted in ancient Vedic and Sanatan traditions. We serve
clients seeking spiritual wellness, stress relief, and mind-body harmony.

## Key Services

- Reiki Healing
- Chakra Alignment & Balancing
- Sound Healing (Singing Bowls)
- Crystal Therapy
- Pranayama & Breath-work
- Guided Meditation
- Yoga & Mindfulness Workshops
